definitions.explanation: A cow raised primarily for milk production, as opposed to beef cattle.

examples.japanese: {乳牛|にゅうぎゅう}の{世話|せわ}をする。
examples.english: To take care of dairy cows.

examples.japanese: この{牧場|ぼくじょう}では{約|やく}{百頭|ひゃくとう}の{乳牛|にゅうぎゅう}を{飼育|しいく}している。
examples.english: This farm raises about one hundred dairy cows.

examples.japanese: {北海道|ほっかいどう}は{日本|にほん}の{乳牛|にゅうぎゅう}{飼育|しいく}の{中心地|ちゅうしんち}で、{国内|こくない}の{生乳|せいにゅう}{生産量|せいさんりょう}の{半分|はんぶん}を{占|し}めている。
examples.english: Hokkaido is the center of dairy farming in Japan, accounting for half of the country's raw milk production.

notes:
A compound of {乳|にゅう} (milk) and {牛|ぎゅう} (cow, cattle). The most common breed in Japan is the Holstein, recognizable by its black-and-white pattern.

Hokkaido is Japan's dairy heartland, producing over half of the nation's milk. Dairy farming is a major part of Hokkaido's identity and economy.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {乳牛|にゅうぎゅう}を{飼|か}う: to raise dairy cows
- {乳牛|にゅうぎゅう}の{搾乳|さくにゅう}: milking of dairy cows
- {乳牛|にゅうぎゅう}{牧場|ぼくじょう}: dairy farm
- {乳牛|にゅうぎゅう}の{飼育|しいく}: dairy cow husbandry

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {肉牛|にくぎゅう}: beef cattle — cows raised for meat
- {牝牛|めうし}: cow (female) — refers to sex rather than purpose
- {酪農|らくのう}: dairy farming — the industry of producing milk and dairy products
